author: priya-raman
title: Reconcile in streaming batches of 5,000 lines
body:
## What

The matcher now reads settlement lines in batches of 5,000 instead of loading the whole day into memory.

## Why

The December file was 3x a normal day and the worker was killed by the out-of-memory killer at 02:41.

## How

Keyset pagination on `settlement_lines.id`. Each batch is matched in its own transaction, so a failure leaves earlier batches committed and the run can resume.

## Testing

Peak memory on the large sample file: 1.9 GB before, 210 MB after.
